text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Colombian President Ernesto Samper ends official visit to Algeria to boost cooperation.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia presides over a task force meeting to assess preparations for the elections.
- Leading figures in the former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) criticise their party leadership over political strategy ahead of the poll.
- Islamist leader Mahfoud Nahnah says his Hamas party hopes to win 40 percent of the vote in the upcoming national assembly election to be held on June 5.
- Political parties reject a government decision forcing them to broadcast campaign message in Arabic on the Algerian French-language radio.
- Negotiations between labour union and state-owned firms over wage hike reached stalemate.
